item.title: More NetBSD-current fun at Linveo!
item.dc:creator: Not_Oles
item.description:
Hello!

  • VPS Share

Would anybody be interested in sharing my free Linveo AMD Ryzen 9 9950X NetBSD VPS in Arizona? It's open to friends who want to help me learn.

  • Goals

Tonight I decided to (1) try some method of rolling release updates of NetBSD pkgsrc. For example, please see pkg_rolling-replace (mailing list, 2008 introduction), please see also the man page. I could use help figuring out the best method of rolling updates with pkgsrc.

Also, I think it might be fun to (2) see whether I can get 9vx working. I could use help with the code and the compiling on 64 bit NetBSD of the vx32 sandboxing library used by 9vx.

Maybe I could (3) try the X Windows installation from pkgsrc instead of the xsrc version, but I haven't looked into pkgsrc X, very much as yet.

  • Procedure

I'm beginning by wiping and reinstalling my NetBSD-current VPS at Linveo. <3 The reinstall is from Linveo vmcontrol, which offers @cmeerw's NetBSD 10.1 image.

The process is installing NetBSD 10.1, then, with changes appropriate for 10.1, following the simple NetBSD 10 to NetBSD-current steps in Quick Recipe For Self-Compiled NetBSD-current On A Linveo VPS.

linveo# ftp -o - https://cdn.netbsd.org/pub/NetBSD/NetBSD-10.1/amd64/binary/sets/comp.tar.xz | progress -z tar xpf - -C /
linveo# which gcc
/usr/bin/gcc
linveo# cd /usr
linveo# mkdir obj src tools
linveo# mkdir /home
linveo# useradd -m -G wheel tom
linveo# passwd tom
Changing password for tom.
New Password:
Retype New Password:
linveo# chown tom obj src tools
linveo# su tom
linveo# 

linveo$ pwd
/usr
linveo$ export CVSROOT="anoncvs@anoncvs.NetBSD.org:/cvsroot"
linveo$ export CVS_RSH="ssh"
linveo$ cvs checkout -A -P src
linveo$ cd src
linveo$ nohup ./build.sh -j 2 -O ../obj -T ../tools -U distribution && \
> nohup ./build.sh -j 2 -O ../obj -T ../tools -U kernel=GENERIC

I like nohup because it gives me a full transcript of all the terminal output and because I don't have to stay connected. Back in the old days I used to start a NetBSD-current build and then sleep. I don't remember a build which failed to complete, but there might have been one.

I will post again, later, or maybe tomorrow, about whether this build completes.

CraneMail Features

Professional Business Email Suite with Collaboration Features

Fully featured business mail suite with all the fixings - cloud file storage & folder sharing, contact and calendar sharing, chat, online meetings (voice/video), tasklist management/notes, and much more. Powered by SmarterMail, you can dive into the full feature set and documentation here.

Amazing Webmail Experience


The webmail user experience has been a huge hit with our beta testers, offering a much more Outlook-like experience for email. Mail, contacts, calendars, online meetings and tasks are closely integrated as you’d expect with something like Google Workspace.

Get more details on the webmail features and additional screenshots here.

Included Cloud Storage


All plans offer a combined amount of storage for mail and files. Easily upload and share large files with family/coworkers or in email/publicly via URL. WebDAV support is still being developed but will be available in the future, so you can utilize the storage with rClone and other desktop sync tools.

Cloud connect features let you sign into your existing cloud storage accounts and browse/manage files, plus copy them over to your CraneMail account.

IMAP/SMTP/POP Support, plus free eM Client Pro licenses

Standard mail options for utilizing the service with your own clients. Also, each domain gets access to 3 free Pro licenses for eM Client.

Built-in Mail Migration

Easily move your mailboxes from your existing providers with the built-in mail migration tool. Provide your existing email account’s login details, or authenticate your gmail/outlook/etc accounts, and start a bulk mail move from your current mail provider that runs in the background.

Gmail/Google Workspace, Outlook/Office365, and standard mail providers with IMAP have worked excellently for our beta testers. iCloud mail migrations haven’t been as successful though.

Premium Spam Filtering from SpamExperts

Bundled with every CraneMail account is spam filtering from SpamExperts. Filtering is done via our on-prem SpamExperts nodes. You get access to the control panel to tune spam filtering settings, release/train mail, and more.

Great Email Deliverability

Mail is sent via our own spam filtering outbound relays to retain our clean sender reputation and make sure the mail we send ends up in the recipient's inbox. We’ve built a sufficient reputation with large mail providers in the last few months and feel confident in our ability to deliver your messages.

Our default sending limits are 300 emails/hour per domain. This isn’t a service for bulk mailing, marketing emails, etc - it’s a primarily inbound business/personal email hosting service.

No Per-Mailbox Costs, Easy Administration

Your domain administrator access allows you to easily add, impersonate (login as), and manage your users. We don’t limit mailboxes so you can create as many as you need without increasing your bill.

Primary domains allowed on each plan are effectively separate overall accounts per-domain. These are limited based on the size of plan you purchase. We don’t limit domain aliases (multiple domains attached to the same mailboxes).

Other Features That Set CraneMail Apart

  • 2-Factor Authentication for Webmail
  • Voice/Video/Text chat (XMPP/Jabber) with external client support, file sharing w/ previews
  • Contact & Calendar Sharing, full CardDAV/CalDAV support
  • Fetch emails from your mailboxes with other email providers - screenshot
  • OnlyOffice web-based document editing for documents/spreadsheets/presentations (BETA)
  • Email archiving - keep an extra copy of in/outbound mail for certain mailboxes, so you never accidentally delete a message (counted against main storage)
  • Simple unsubscribe for newsletters/mailing lists
  • Much much much more. Seriously we can’t list it all, this would be 10x as long. Check out SmarterMail’s site for the full feature set.

Technical Details

CraneMail nodes use ZFS-backed storage with mirrored NVMe storage for mail. Offsite backups are taken daily for disaster recovery purposes only - not individual account restores or accidental email deletion (use the Email Archiving feature!). Backup frequency will increase in coming months. 10 gigabit networking for fast uploads/file sharing.

At launch CraneMail is only available in our US (Las Vegas) datacenter.

View CraneMail Launch/Black Friday Deal Plans Here

Reseller Plans

We’re also launching reseller plans today which include all of the above features, but allow you to resell custom plans to your own clients. We’re proud of the feature set as it stands, but are still actively developing reseller functionality.

White Label Server Names & Login Page URL

Domains selected/connected to the service are whitelabeled, plus as a reseller you have the ability to create a custom login page on your domain. Your customers can easily login to their webmail/administration or SpamExperts directly.

As we add servers/locations, the login page will stay the same and allow for a single point of login no matter which server a specific client is on. Branding, customization and more for this page is currently being developed.

Extensive Plan Customization & Upsell Potential

Create very precise, custom plans for your clients and upsell them on the features we include. Limit accounts by the standard specs: disk space, mailbox count, and aliases. You can also include or upsell specific features like email archiving, SpamExperts filtering, cloud/file storage features, and the (still in beta) online document editing.

WHMCS & Blesta Billing Modules

Francisco has been working hard the past week and launched both WHMCS and Blesta billing modules so you can easily deploy, modify, suspend, and terminate customer accounts.

Modules are available on the NameCrane Github:
WHMCS Module
Blesta Module

Reseller Launch Discount

As we’re still actively building out the reseller featureset to allow more tweaking and customization we’re extending a first invoice launch discount.

Use the coupon mailresellerlaunch30 for a 30% discount on your first invoice - any sized plan, any billing term.

View all CraneMail Reseller plans here.

Update Nov 30th: Primary Domain limits increased to 15 each on the Black Friday Plan & Lifetime. Sending limit increased to 600 emails sent/hr per domain on all plans. These changes will be bulk applied to all who have already purchased as well.

item.title: TierHive - NAT VPS & Static Hosting - Vouchers for free tokens inside - 12 locations
item.dc:creator: AnthonySmith
item.description:
TierHive in a nutshell is a NAT VPS, its KVM based, and a little bit different, every customer is assigned a /24 from 10.0.0.0/8 and your /24 works across all 12 locations, you can assign an IP to your VPS, and you get up to 10 NAT ports per VPS that forward from the external IP to any port you want on your VPS. If you want to use 80/443 externally, we have HAProxy, which can also handle SSL for you.

We only charge for what you use 1 hour in advance, if you shut down, you are only billed for the storage not the compute.

Sign up, add $3 (minimum) or use a voucher code, and then start creating VPS.

We also offer lifetime free tier static hosting for anyone who makes a single payment ever, and you get to use the credit from your payment on the VPS side of things anyway.

We now have around 30 public recipes for deploying everything automatically from WireGuard to Flarum to Laravel. You can see more on https://tierhive.com/ on the recipe marketplace scroller.

Read more here if you want to know about how it works in terms of allocations and limits https://tierhive.com/about.php

It worked, but it was never really built for this. So we rebuilt the lot. We've resolved countless issues, streamlined everything end to end and launched a fully bespoke platform of our own. Every plan comes with 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, a 25 GB SSD OS disk, 5 TB of monthly transfer on a 400 Mbps port and a dedicated IPv4 address. Storage sits on our ZFS-backed enterprise SAS array.
